We validate our approach using 7 different base models from 3 different sources, across 12 datasets covering math reasoning, code generation, and commonsense reasoning.

In the mathematical reasoning tasks, we fine-tune the model on a 100K subset of the MetaMathQA dataset and evaluate transfer performance on GSM8K and MATH datasets. In the code generation tasks, we fine-tune the model on the CodeFeedback105K dataset and evaluate performance on HumanEval and MBPP datasets.
